source.kind: self-authored diagnostic, not a competition or retrieval evaluation

model_input.question: Which category has the larger count, and what is the difference between the two counts?

response_schema.winner: category label, or empty on refusal
response_schema.value: numeric difference, or null on refusal
response_schema.unit: measurement unit, never a numeric difference
response_schema.citations: source identity plus original-image pixel bbox covering the required labels, values and context

formal_product_output_contract: Existing main-project status/answer/citations v2; numerical values and units are stated in answer text. No diagnostic value/unit fixture is injected into real-question inference.
